test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about the procedure of calculating balancing of crankshaft of an engine?

options.text: It involves determining the balancing couple and counterweight mass required to balance the crankshaft.
To balance a crankshaft, metal can be removed by drilling holes on the 'heavy' side until balance is achieved.
Crankshaft balancing involves calculating the rotating and reciprocating masses of a crankshaft.
To balance a crankshaft, metal can be added by welding material deposition on the 'heavy' side until balance is achieved.

solution:
The correct answer is __Option 4**(To balance a crankshaft, metal can be added by welding material deposition on the 'heavy' side until balance is achieved.)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Balancing a crankshaft__ is essential to reduce vibrations and improve engine efficiency.
 
• It involves determining the balancing couple and counterweight mass required to balance the crankshaft.
 
• Metal can be removed by drilling holes on the 'heavy' side until balance is achieved.
 
• Calculating the rotating and reciprocating masses of the crankshaft is a vital step in the balancing process.
 
• Adding material by welding deposition is not a recommended method as it can affect the structural integrity of the crankshaft.
